milestone.title: Mandatory independent review phase: execute→review→remediate cycle + review queue

intent.outcome: Autonomous execution is always followed by an independent review pass before work is considered shipped: AGENTS.md codifies the execution contract and the review cadence, and `mp review` gives a reviewer a frictionless queue of completed-but-unreviewed milestones with a sign-off command.

problem.description: Two autonomous runs drifted in ways automated gates cannot catch. The M62 guardrail stops 'red tests marked green' (mechanical), and M60's W40-W43 catch poorly-groomed specs. But both runs also shipped SEMANTIC drift — wrong/missing implementations with passing or absent tests: M54's review CLI was entirely absent (no test failed because no test covered it); M52 shipped the wrong W30 semantics and its test passed. Only an independent fresh-eyes pass (comparing implementation to spec/ACs) caught these. Today review is opt-in (M57 code_review defaults off) and there is no queue or tracking for 'completed and awaiting review', so nothing makes the review pass routine. Worse: the process rules ('never complete on red tests', 'verification steps are mandatory', 'block+report, never fake completion') lived only in SESSION-HANDOFF.md, which was deleted — they have no permanent home. Honest caveat encoded in the spec: tooling makes review routine and visible; it CANNOT verify a review was good. The judgment of 'does this do what the spec meant' stays a fresh-eyes pass — this milestone guarantees that pass HAPPENS every time and is low-friction, not that it is automatic.

in_scope: Resurrect the execution-contract rules into AGENTS.md as a permanent section (never in a scratch handoff): never complete on red tests; a step tests value is a gate, not a suggestion; verification/dogfood steps are mandatory; on unfixable failure block+report, never fake completion; one commit per milestone; re-run mp validate after each completion.

Document the execute->review->remediate cadence in AGENTS.md as mandatory: autonomous execution is ALWAYS followed by an independent review pass (a different session/context than the executor) before work is considered shipped.

Bake 'verify, don't trust' into the review cadence: the reviewer reads the execution report FIRST, then verifies its claims against the diff/tests. The report and the agent's notes are claims — and the place drift can hide (the M62 summary said '0 failures' masking a flaky test) — never proof.

Add `mp reviews pending`: lists milestones with execution_status=done that have no review record (or were completed/recompleted after their last review), with a pointer to each milestone's spec/ACs so a reviewer has a frictionless queue.

Add `mp reviews pass <milestone> --verdict ok|changes-needed --reviewer <who> [--notes ...]`: records a review sign-off (verdict, reviewer, date) so the milestone leaves the pending queue. Re-review after re-completion updates the record.
Add `mp reviews list`/`show` for review history.

Add read-only `mp execution report`: for milestones in the review queue, compile step statuses (done/skipped/failed) + evidence + block_reasons + AC pass/fail, and surface each milestone's execution notes. The executing agent records its narrative (deviations from spec, deferred/skipped work + reason, decisions/assumptions) via the existing `mp note add` so drift is declared explicitly rather than buried. This report is what the reviewer reads first.
Surface the pending-review count in `mp status` so a reviewer knows work is waiting.

Update the master-planner skill and docs to reference the review phase (execute->review->remediate) so agents know the full cycle, including the expectation to record an execution narrative (notes) at handoff.
out_of_scope: The completion guardrail itself (done in M62, hardened to bare-path tests in M63).
Reviewer-identity enforcement / blocking completion unless reviewer != executor (chosen NOT to build — review independence is a process expectation, not a hard gate).
Automated verification of review quality (impossible — review substance is judgment).
A separate reviewer-agent binary/profile (the parked agent-profiles idea).
Changing M57's in-flow code_review step gate (this milestone's review PASS is post-completion and complementary).
A new narrative write command (reuse mp note add; only the read-side mp execution report is new).
